preconditions.description: Input consists of two integers n (2 ≤ n ≤ 2000) and k (1 ≤ k ≤ 10^9) separated by space.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'no solution' or (len(stdout.strip().split()) == 2 * int(stdin.split()[0]) and all('|' + line.split()[0] + '| <= 10**9 and |' + line.split()[1] + '| <= 10**9' for line in stdout.strip().split() if line.strip()))
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output 'no solution'. Otherwise, output n distinct points with coordinates satisfying |xi|, |yi| ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: any('no solution' != stdout.strip() and all(line1 != line2 for line1 in stdout.strip().split() for line2 in stdout.strip().split() if line1 != line2))
any('no solution' != stdout.strip() and all('|' + line.split()[0] + '| <= 10**9 and |' + line.split()[1] + '| <= 10**9' for line in stdout.strip().split()))

any('no solution' != stdout.strip() and any(all('|' + line.split()[0] + '| <= 10**9 and |' + line.split()[1] + '| <= 10**9' for line in stdout.strip().split()) and (lambda p: sum(1 for i in range(len(p)) for j in range(i+1, len(p)) if (p[j][0] - p[i][0]) < (p[j][1] - p[i][1])**2 + (p[j][0] - p[i][0])**2) > int(stdin.split()[1]))(list(map(lambda l: tuple(map(int, l.split())), stdout.strip().split())))))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the generated points must cause the given code to compute tot > k by ensuring many pairs violate the break condition (p[j].x - p[i].x >= d).
